verdict: GBP engagement is the biggest story this period, with 413 total actions (44 calls, 87 directions, 282 web clicks) over 28 days, though GBP activity dropped sharply by 84.42% in the last 7 days, likely reflecting reduced local search demand or a listing visibility issue. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive.

performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; renewal spend not yet deployed after Aug 1.

findings.text: All paid channels show $0 spend across the full 28-day window — Meta, Google Ads, and Search Console clicks are all zero. Renewal started Aug 1; no campaigns are live.
SOW milestone: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event recorded — now 17 days overdue.
GBP actions collapsed from ~25/day mid-August to 0 on Aug 28–29 (–84% 7d delta); last 3 days avg 1.3 vs prior-3 avg 9.3 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
GA4 sessions held broadly flat (last-3 avg 265 vs prior-3 avg 272, –3%) despite zero paid traffic — organic/direct is sustaining site volume, but no purchases are firing.
Purchases and revenue report zero for the entire 45-day series; with Shopify pixel known to misfire on Meta events, this is a data gap — not confirmed zero sales.

suggestions.text: Launch at least one Meta campaign immediately; $0 spend 31 days into a $1,000–1,500/mo renewal is a full billing-cycle loss.
suggestions.monday_update: Paid spend has been $0 across all channels for every day since the Aug 1 renewal start — confirmed across 28-day totals and the full 45-day series. The SOW calls for ~$1,000–1,500/mo in Meta ad spend; at $0/day for 31 days the client has received none of that deliverable. Action: activate at least one Meta campaign (stock-footage creative, broad audience per the June restructure that produced 3.8–4.6x) by end of this week. Success check: spend > $0 confirmed in Windsor/Meta reporting by 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing — zero actions on Aug 28–29 after a 25/day mid-August baseline warrants an immediate listing health check.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped from a mid-August average of ~25/day to 0 on Aug 28–29, a confirmed 3-day signal (last-3 avg 1.3 vs prior-3 avg 9.3). This could indicate a listing suspension, a visibility penalty, or a data reporting lag. Action: log into Google Business Profile dashboard and verify listing status, check for any policy flags or pending reinstatement, and confirm data is flowing. Success check: GBP actions return above 10/day within 3 days of any corrective action, confirmed by 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Watch Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (17 days overdue): no creative asset delivery, no campaign can launch with new footage.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Shoot 1 milestone was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event on record — it is 17 days overdue as of today. Real facility footage (Haney's July 21 Drive delivery) was a key creative unlock; this shoot is the next planned asset for the Video board. Action: Nacer to confirm shoot status with the Video/Content team and set a firm rescheduled date. Success check: shoot date confirmed and on the board by 2026-09-07; if not completed by then, escalate to Sohib as a billing-cycle creative risk.
